prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Command Center Screen: Add a dedicated control center screen explaining how to summon, move, hide, and interact with your pet before finishing setup. (why: Support mails highlight user confusion after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Verification Status: Display a live desktop engine status indicator on the waiting screen while pet assets render in the background. (why: Support received emails about pets failing to appear on desktop, and home stage median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s). Clear status updates reduce dropoff.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Sync & Recovery Hint: Add an explicit reassurance hint under sign-in options promising that previously adopted pets are automatically recovered upon login. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Display Compatibility Hint: Display a compatibility hint on the story screen confirming support for multi-monitor setups and taskbar display. (why: Multiple support tickets report issues with desktop rendering or window positioning during initial launch.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Creation Photo Diagnostic Screen: Insert a photo quality verification screen right after photo upload to preview and validate the custom pet image format. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect after upload.)

scores.note: Finish step has high dropoff (35.2%) and post-onboarding support complaints, but introducing a new screen adds friction/cost.
Extremely long wait times at home stage (median 201s, mean 2336s) backed by support reports make status indication high-leverage.
Sign-in already has high conversion (90.1%), limiting impact despite being top support email theme.
Low cost hint on choose_path step, but low targeted impact on early dropoff.
Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck (36.8% dropoff), though adding a full diagnostic screen carries development cost.
